name: Rigid Industries 40281 Bare Anti-Theft Kit for LED Light Bar
description: Universal Bare Stainless Steel Anti-Theft Kit for LED Light Bar (40281) by Rigid Industries. 1 Set. Keep your lights where you mounted them with this Rigid Industries anti-theft kit designed to make a potential thiefs job much more difficult. Made from high-strength stainless steel, it provides exceptional durability. This kit includes two 2.25 x 20 spanner nuts, four spacer washers, and one 1/4" hex nut bit. It is designed to work with cradle and weld-on mounts.
